canonical_name: Suppliers Not Included in Incident Planning and Response
description: Relevant suppliers and third parties are not included in cybersecurity exercises.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of supplier involvement in incident planning, response exercises, and recovery activities. Check for lack of coordination mechanisms or communication channels with critical suppliers during incident scenarios.
